Core weight to lower-volatility software platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) for resilience and recurring cash flows; satellite exposure to the AI compute cycle via NVIDIA to capture secular upside. Use staged entries and periodic rebalancing to manage volatility; no reinvestment assumed.
